name: rating
description: Records every agent turn (prompt, tools, answer, skills, usage) as a dataset, with your 1-5 ratings from /rate or the band and automatic weak labels from the next prompt, for analysis and fine-tuning. /ratings reports it

datasetDir.title: Dataset folder
datasetDir.description: Folder of the turns, ratings and signals JSONL files. A leading ~ is the home folder

band.title: Rating band
band.description: Show the 1-5 rating row above the prompt after each answer
